preconditions.description: T is an integer between 1 and 1000 inclusive, representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(S, str) and S.islower() and S.isalpha() and 1 <= len(S) <= 200000 for S in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:T+1]])
preconditions.description: Each string S consists only of lowercase English letters and has length between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(output_line.isdigit() and 0 <= int(output_line) <= len(S) for S, output_line in zip([line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:T+1]], stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is a non-negative integer not exceeding the length of the input string S, representing the number of palindromic cyclic shifts.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output_line) == sum(1 for k in range(len(S)) if (S[k:] + S[:k]) == (S[k:] + S[:k])[::-1]) for S, output_line in zip([line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:T+1]], stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is the count of all cyclic shifts of S that are palindromic, where a cyclic shift is formed by moving k characters from the start to the end of S.
